s1_dominant.description: B dominates: P50=100 ms ($0.5/M). A is slow (P50=1100 ms) and expensive ($2/M).

s2_tradeoff.description: A: cheap ($0.5/M) + slow (P50=500 ms, P99=1600 ms). B: expensive ($2/M) + fast (P50=100 ms).

s3_tail.description: A: P50=100 ms but P99=5 s (heavy tail). B: P50=300 ms, P99=1 s (stable). Both cost $1/M.

s4_shift.description: A: fast (P50=100 ms) until t=30 min, then slow (P50=1000 ms). B: constant P50=300 ms. Both cost $1/M.
s4_shift.name: s4_shift
